resource_guards.limitations: Polling can overshoot; group RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; workdir logical sizes exclude symlinks and stop counting after the bound is crossed.

resource_accounting.cpu_scope: direct child plus descendants accounted for by child wait
resource_accounting.rss_scope: kernel peak, not simultaneous process-tree total
resource_accounting.monitor_cpu_scope: macOS libproc is included in parent CPU; other-platform ps helper CPU is monitor_cpu_seconds
